data.name: Aabdar
data.gender_notes: Aabdar is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who worships and serves Allah with utmost devotion, dedication, and obedience. The name Aabdar carries the meaning “Servant of Allah” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Aabdar usually hope their child will grow to embody servant of allah and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A reminder to live a life fully devoted to Allah, seeking His pleasure and guidance.
data.etymology: Aabdar belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Servant of Allah.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aabdar total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_arabic.name: ءابدار
in_arabic.long_meaning: ءابدار هو اسمٌ عربيٌّ مشتقٌّ من الجذر العجميّ، وَهو مُشتَقٌّ من كلمة العُبّاد، وَهِيَ شَيءٌ يُرى في الفضاء السَماويّ قبل أَن يَصبح مُعَرّكًا، وَهذا الاسم يُشير إلى مَن يَضىء في حياته وَيَشرق في فكره، وَهو مِن الأسماء التي تجمل الحِقّة الحقيقيّة في الإِسلام، وَهُوَ يُستخدمُ في الأَسماء المُحَلّى في الأَسر المُسلمة في عِلم الأَسماء المُحَلّى، وَهُوَ يَملك مَعنيًّا عظيمًا في التَفسير العِلميّ، وَهُوَ يَستخدم في تَفسير النُبوة وَالإِرشاد لِلناس

in_urdu.name: ءابدار
in_urdu.meaning: ءابدار کا مطلب ہے بارق مشرق
in_urdu.long_meaning: ءابدار ایک عربی نام ہے جو عجمی جڑ سے مشتق ہے، یہ نام عُباد سے ملا ہے، جو کہ ایک چیز ہے جو آسمان میں دیکھی جا سکتی ہے جب یہ منفک ہونے سے پہلے ہوتی ہے، یہ نام وہ شخص کی علامت ہے جو اپنی زندگی میں روشنی ڈالتا ہے اور اپنے فکر میں روشنی ڈالتا ہے، یہ نام مسلمانوں کے لیے حقیقی حقیقت کا نمونہ ہے، یہ نام مسلمانوں کے گھرانوں میں استعمال ہوتا ہے، یہ نام علم ناموں میں استعمال ہوتا ہے، یہ نام علم کی دنیا میں بڑا مطلب رکھتا ہے، یہ نام نبوئیات اور انسانوں کو راہنمائی کے لیے استعمال ہوتا ہے

in_hindi.name: ءाबदर
in_hindi.meaning: आबदर का अर्थ है बारिक मुक्षिक
in_hindi.long_meaning: आबदर एक अरबी नाम है जो अजमी जड़ से मिला है, यह नाम उबाद से मिला है, जो एक चीज़ है जो आकाश में देखी जा सकती है जब वह विभाजित होने से पहले होती है, यह नाम वो व्यक्ति की सूचक है जो अपने जीवन में प्रकाश डालता है और अपने विचार में प्रकाश डालता है, यह नाम मुसलमानों के लिए वास्तविक वास्तविकता का प्रतीक है, यह नाम मुसलमानों के परिवारों में उपयोग किया जाता है, यह नाम नाम विज्ञान में उपयोग किया जाता है, यह नाम विज्ञान की दुनिया में बड़ा अर्थ रखता है, यह नाम नबुओतियों और लोगों को मार्गदर्शन के लिए उपयोग किया जाता है

in_pashto.name: ءابدار
in_pashto.meaning: ءابدار دا مطلب د بارګ مشرګ دى
in_pashto.long_meaning: ءابدار يو عربي نوم دى چې د عجمي څخه مينځته راغلی دى، دا نوم د عباد څخه پيدا سوى، يوښه چيز دى چې آسمان کې ديدل کيږي وکړه چې په پوځ کي پوره کوږ سوى، دا نوم يو شخص دى چې په خپل ژوند کي پرتو رغلی او خپلو فکرونو کي پرتو رغلی دى، دا نوم مسلمانو لپاره يو حقيقي حقيقت دى، دا نوم مسلمانو کښلنو کي په کار کي دى، دا نوم علمي علم کي دى، دا نوم علمي دنيا کي يو بله مطلب دى، دا نوم نبوئياتو او انسانو ته په رايح کي دى

in_english.name: Aabdar
in_english.meaning: Aabdar means radiant and shining one, bringing light and illumination
in_english.long_meaning: Aabdar is a name of Arabic origin, derived from the root 'ubad', meaning a light seen in the sky before dawn. It signifies one who radiates light in their life and illuminates their thoughts, embodying the true essence of Islam. This name is used in Muslim communities worldwide, and its significance extends to the spiritual realm, representing a person who illuminates the path for others. In Islamic tradition, Aabdar is considered a name that carries profound meaning, associated with spiritual growth, enlightenment, and guidance.

historical_references.reference: Ibn al-Athir records the name Aabdar in his book Al-Kamel fi al-Tarikh, mentioning a Persian Sultan named Aabdar Mohammad who ruled over Fars and Kerman from 1153 to 1174 CE. During his reign, he faced several internal and external threats including the Seljuk Turks and the Nizari Ismailis. Aabdar was noted for his military prowess and successfully repelled invasions from his enemies.
historical_references.context: Persian Sultan of Fars and Kerman, faced threats from Seljuk Turks and Nizari Ismailis, known for military prowess

historical_references.reference: Al-Maqrizi, in his book Al-Sawa'iq al-Muhriqa, mentions a Mamluk Sultan named Aabdar Khan who ruled from 1382 to 1390 CE. He was a slave who rose to power under Sultan An-Nasir Hasan, and was noted for his military campaigns against the Mongols. He expanded the Mamluk territories in Egypt and Syria and is remembered as one of the most successful military commanders in Mamluk history.
historical_references.context: Mamluk Sultan, rose to power as a slave, noted for military campaigns against Mongols, expanded Mamluk territories in Egypt and Syria

modern_usage.modern_context: The name 'Aabdar' is a classic Islamic name, often associated with the Prophet Muhammad's companion, Abu Bakr As-Siddiq, who was also known as 'Aabdar Allah' (servant of Allah). In modern contexts, this name has gained popularity as a contemporary expression of Islamic identity and naming practices. The name 'Aabdar' is now seen on various platforms such as social media, baby name websites, and within Muslim communities. For instance, on social media, there are profiles with the name 'Aabdar' that showcase Islamic art, poetry, and inspiration. On baby name websites, 'Aabdar' is listed as a popular Islamic name for boys. In Muslim communities, families may choose to name their child 'Aabdar' as a way to honor their Islamic heritage and upbringing.
